tools.name: contact_business
tools.description: Prepare a contact request to the business for service inquiries, pricing, booking, support, or follow-up. This tool fills available contact forms but does not submit without user action.

tools.name: request_shipping_quote
tools.description: Prepare a shipping quote request for international shipping, furniture shipping, cargo shipping, car shipping, customs clearance, pickup, and delivery. Use this tool when the user wants a price estimate or shipping arrangement.

origin.description: Pickup city or origin country, such as Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Saudi Arabia, or Egypt.

destination.description: Destination city or country, such as London, Dubai, United Kingdom, Emirates, France, or Netherlands.

shipment_type.description: Shipment type such as furniture, car, commercial goods, personal items, documents, or parcels.

details.description: Additional shipment details, sizes, number of boxes, car model, customs questions, or delivery notes.

tools.name: site_search
tools.description: Search this website for articles, services, destinations, shipping routes, customs information, and company pages.

query.description: Search query entered by the user.
